main.description: Delete the requester's appearance setting kept after it stopped being a member (getAppearance with includeRetained answers it with retainedUntil), if rev is its rev. Idempotent: with no kept setting (already released, past retainedUntil whether or not it has been deleted yet, or never kept) it succeeds with the same empty answer and does nothing; rev is checked only against a kept setting. Requires auth; not for current members, whose setting changes only through putAppearance.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The input is malformed, or the caller is a community member.

errors.name: InvalidSwap
errors.description: A setting is kept for the requester and rev is not its rev. Nothing was deleted; read it again with getAppearance and includeRetained.
